boundaries.dispatch: current-thread block_on of real dispatch_data plus dispatch_watermark_handler on a RollingOperator, including the rolling collector, edge enqueue and callback publication; no projection; output drain outside the timer

limitations: One evidence round: a controller pairs fresh-process rounds of two binaries (profile_warm_stream.py native).
Allocation counts are thread-local; the dispatch fixtures run on the calling thread.
Test binaries install the counting global allocator for every allocation, timed or not, in both arms.
Recorder-present numeric_update time comes from the arm's cumulative rolling metrics around each timed dispatch.
